submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "Cough, Sneeze, Laugh = Pain Logistics"
finding.problem: "I held the pillow like they said but I still screamed when I sneezed. Then I realised I'd missed my pain med and didn't know if I could take it while breastfeeding."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 27-yr-old Enugu mom with a cold plus newborn; every sneeze feels like her scar splits; she forgot her 6-hour painkiller dose and panicked.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module / bonus checklist (pain-med timing + breastfeeding-safe table, sneeze technique).". Verdict: PASSES (3/5).
